blocks.text: Members' safety forum · September 17, 2026 · open floor
Anyone else? Yes, at the back.
Leona Bracken, Bracken Freight. I'll say it here, because I said it to the freight association and nobody wanted to hear it.
Last spring I told public works the Mile 14 crossing wouldn't take another loaded season, and I asked them to close it to trucks.
They closed it in April, and in May the bridge gave out with nothing on it.
Thank you, Leona. That's one we should all know about. Mott, your crew was out there, wasn't it?

Mott Peppercombe, Brickway Works bridge crew. We put the truck barriers in at Mile 14 in April, the week after the committee decided. I was there the morning the deck went. You hear it before you see it. There was nothing on it, and that's the whole point of what Leona did.
Abel Wickridge, Wickridge Haulage. I'll be honest, I grumbled. The closure put time on every run I make out of Eastfield. I rerouted through Bluebell Crossing and I'd do it again tomorrow.
